reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistently no redline or comment was proposed — appropriate for a retained internal evidence finding.

The cited paragraphs contain no MFN or 'no less favorable' obligation burdening AbbVie (our party as Licensee/Customer): Section 4.3 grants AbbVie sole control of terms of sale, pricing and discounts, and Section 5.9.3/5.9 is an elective opt-in to future in-licensed rights rather than a duty to extend Harpoon terms given to third parties.

Rationale correctly identifies the closest third-party-terms mechanic and explains why it is not an MFN burden; it also correctly notes the commercial provisions run in our favour, matching the rule's preferred position (no MFN on Customer).
No deterministic check failures and no over-flagging risk, since nothing is redlined.
